differential.rationale: Long‑standing type 2 diabetes with microalbuminuria and GFR ≈ 36 mL/min is classic for diabetic kidney disease.

differential.name: Hypertensive nephrosclerosis
differential.rationale: Co‑existing metabolic syndrome and likely elevated BP can cause arteriolar sclerosis leading to CKD stage 3.

differential.name: Obesity‑related glomerulopathy
differential.rationale: BMI ≈ 28 kg/m² with metabolic syndrome predisposes to focal segmental glomerulosclerosis and progressive CKD.

differential.name: Atherosclerotic renal artery stenosis
differential.rationale: Dyslipidemia and CKD with borderline anemia raise suspicion for ischemic renal injury from renal artery disease.

differential.name: Anemia of chronic kidney disease
differential.rationale: CKD with reduced erythropoietin production explains the documented anemia in this patient.
